bends.note: angle point: the SW leg (dx/dy about -1.65, i.e. running ENE-WSW at ~31 deg) turns onto the NNE leg (dx/dy ~-0.55) that runs to the top edge; the SW leg itself curves gently (building lines steepen from slope ~-0.6 near May to ~-0.85 near Presley/Boone)
gentle curve point on the SW leg between May (slope ~-0.6) and Presley/Boone (slope ~-0.87)
angle point: leaves Gilbert running SE (about 40 deg), then turns due south to Morris

ends.note: west end: circular turnaround (about 70 ft across) at the head of the place; point is the centre of the circle

notes: Mt Auburn / Gilbert Avenue. Names printed without a suffix (BOONE, MANITOU, MAY, KENTON, NASSAU, MORRIS) recorded as '... Street' to match sheets 176, 177 and 179 ('MORRIS ST.' on 179). Presley Alley is printed 'PRESLEY ALLEY' (20'); it runs through the block north of Manitou too. Manitou east of May runs into Florence Av.: the small triangle block (lot 701) lies between them, east of it Manitou's south side opens into Florence; the T is where Manitou's centreline (y~1281) meets the SW-leg centreline of Florence. Florence's SW leg is computed as the midline of its two building lines (60'); its NNE leg is centred between the east building line and a line 60 ft west of it (agrees with the 20 in. pipe). Kenton: two pieces. (1) The N-S Kenton Street (label 'KENTON' at x~2190, between the block line at x~2131 and a line at x~2295) comes down from sheet 187 and opens into the Manitou/Florence space; its T is where its centreline (x~2213) meets Florence's NNE-leg centreline, practically at the Florence angle point. (2) The 25 ft street printed 'KENTON' at the top (a paste on its south side reads 'NO NAME ST.') runs ESE from Florence's east line to Gilbert; recorded as 'Kenton Street (east of Florence)'. Between them the 'KENTON STREET BRIDGE' (dashed outline) crosses over Florence running SSE; its dashed lines continue SSE across the lots east of Florence to Gilbert's west line near lot 2185 (~2650,1360). Not recorded as an intersection (grade-separated, and its landing at Gilbert is not clear); whether Kenton (east of Florence) meets Florence at grade or only via the bridge is not certain - the T at (2556,485) is given because lots 2218/2220 Florence front the corner. Gilbert Av. is 100'; Nassau (55', 60' on sheet 179) comes from the right and ends at Gilbert's east line; Morris (50', 4 in. pipe) also ends at Gilbert (Eden Park south of Morris), same junction as on sheet 177. Deerfield Pl. (printed 'DEERFIELD PL.', 50') leaves Gilbert's east side SE, then turns south to Morris. Bella Vista Pl. (printed 'BELLA VISTA PL.', 40') runs west from Sinton to a circular turnaround. Sinton Av. (printed 'SINTON AV. (GRAND)') runs along the right edge; only its west building line is on this sheet, so its centre is taken 85 px (25 ft) east of that line, using the 50 ft width it has on sheet 179 (its east line is off the paper here). Boone/Florence: Boone (50') ends at Florence near the left edge; centre from Boone's east line and pipe, Florence centre from its pipe. Arden (ending at Boone on sheets 176/177) is not drawn on this sheet.
